concerns.concern: The phenomenological RSJ model is heavily reverse-engineered with extreme exponents and does not microscopically explain how interactions between SC1 and SC2 vortices produce the proposed potential landscape. A molecular-dynamics simulation of two interacting vortex species with different core sizes or pinning potentials would provide much better physical insight.
concerns.quote: While useful as a proof-of-concept dynamical toy model, it does not microscopically explain *how* the interaction between SC1 and SC2 vortices generates this specific potential landscape.

concerns.concern: The introduction overstates the practical application of the findings to AI data centers and sustainable computing, given that the memory effect requires extreme operating conditions including temperatures below 600 mK, magnetic fields of 7 to 20 T, and a radioactive actinide compound.
concerns.quote: the technological framing in the introduction is somewhat overstated relative to the experimental conditions.

concerns.concern: The Supplementary Information referenced on page 12 of the text, including temperature-versus-time traces during current pulses and Figs. S2 and S7, is missing from the manuscript file and needs to be attached or linked.
concerns.quote: On page 12, the text refers to *"Supplementary Information"* (specifically mentioning temperature-versus-time traces during current pulses and Fig. S2/S7), which is not attached to this main file

concerns.concern: In the right panel of Extended Data Fig. 1a, the x-axis label for excitation current density has the wrong units, displaying milliseconds instead of amperes per square centimeter.
concerns.quote: The x-axis is labelled "$J_{\text{ex}}\text{ (ms)}$". The unit for current density should be $\text{(A cm}^{-2}\text{)}$, not milliseconds.

concerns.concern: On page 9, paragraph 1, the phrase referring to Extended Data Fig. 5 is redundant and should be corrected from "timescale- and duration-tuning" to "relaxation-rate and duration-tuning".
concerns.quote: The text mentions *"timescale- and duration-tuning, as shown in Extended Data Fig. 5"*, which is redundant; it should read *"relaxation-rate and duration-tuning"*.
